page.overview:
Who is Ufim?

Ufim was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Ufim was a pyon who served House Harkonnen in Carthag. His cousin had disappeared, having been said to be an agitator, to none could say what he did.

As he prepared to test a long throw cutteray auger with an ungraded barrel, he warned Dayvan of the potential dangers of doing so. Dayvan agreed, but pointed out that they had direct orders from Piter de Vries. Once everything was set up, they activated the cutteray, only for it to go out of phase, vaporize the beam splitter and empty the charge onto Areg, killing him. Horrified by what they had witnessed, the rest of the pyons were ordered to continue their shifts.
